purpose: Prospective Stage-3 identification design v2 for partner-force autonomy. This design integrates the preflight treatment-relevance gate verified environment (resolving spatial segregation, active Close Air Support, and multi-channel partner support binding) varying indigenous force-generation, logistics, and command capacity together with removable support composition, then performing paired support-on/support-off branching at T without any persistent capacity-building policy mechanism.

components: fielded military personnel retention relative to the shared T baseline
operational military formation survival relative to the shared T baseline
military geographic coverage retention relative to the shared T baseline
capability_assay.composite: unweighted geometric mean of the four bounded [0,1] behavioral components
capability_assay.predictor_firewall: Training throughput, logistics throughput, command reliability, readiness, experience, and external-support ledgers are excluded from the composite capability outcome.

indigenous_design.force_generation_multiplier: multiplies security recruitment and training rates
indigenous_design.logistics_multiplier: multiplies indigenous logistics source daily production fraction
indigenous_design.command_multiplier: applied at initialization to indigenous formation command and command-edge reliability, with inverse scaling of indigenous latency

non_saturation_justification.air_intensity: Levels 0.08, 0.35, 0.90 cover light to decisive fire support without trivializing insurgent survival or causing floor/ceiling saturation in combat.
non_saturation_justification.logistics_throughput: Levels 100, 450, 1200 supply units/day span austerity, replacement, and high surge without exceeding formation storage buffers.
non_saturation_justification.command_advisory: Boosts 0.05, 0.18, 0.55 and latency reductions 0.05, 0.20, 0.55 ensure effective reliability r_eff remains below 1.0 and latency stays above the physical minimum floor.
non_saturation_justification.force_generation: Training boosts 0.0015, 0.006, 0.035 day^-1 accelerate training throughput without depleting the recruit pipeline to zero.

support_design.warning: Stage 3 identifies autonomy and dependence. It must not be interpreted as a comparison of optimal assistance policies.

preflight_gate.mechanism_verification: Automated preflight treatment-relevance gate verifying 12 representative worlds across combat liveness, air support, logistics delivery, forcegen replacements, command advisory, counterfactual exactness on negative controls, and treated branch divergence before campaign launch.

execution_gate: The Rust runner requires --execute and passes --preflight-gate. Without --execute, it prints the design and exits before creating a SimulationEngine.

model_selection_protocol.rationale: Long-horizon resilience (90d and 180d) directly evaluates post-withdrawal autonomy without being dominated by short-term 7d/30d inertia carryover.
model_selection_protocol.horizon_fitting: After selecting the winning coordinate Omega* on target horizons [90, 180], horizon-specific mappings f_h(Omega*) are fitted for all h in [7, 30, 90, 180].
